source.title: Finding Investors Is Also a Job
source.subtitle: Define the right person. Build the profile. Then go search.
source.summary: Fundraising works better when it becomes deliberate matching instead of random outreach.

body.text: Finding investors is not a lottery. Start by defining who you actually need in the room.
The first move is not sending more cold messages. It is writing a clear profile: do you need sector access, conviction, decision speed, or long-term support?
Fundraising is not begging. It is matching.

items: Define the role your ideal investor should play
Write down filters, signals, and red lines
Search channels and names against that profile
